say:2:1530449001:1.text: There's so much to worry about. The Wild Moon has fallen. So many warriors didn't make it back...
say:2:1530449001:1.source_cn: 要担忧的事可太多了。雅库伯尔之月陨落，战士们伤亡惨重……

say:3:1530449002:1.text: Without the Herdmaster watching over us, I'm afraid hunting's only going to get harder.
say:3:1530449002:1.source_cn: 失去了兽群之主的庇护，恐怕以后狩猎会变得更难。

say:4:1530449003:1.text: The peaceful days we once had, I doubt they're ever coming back...
say:4:1530449003:1.source_cn: 以前那种安稳的生活，很可能再也回不来了哟……
